intro: What a shipment from this site starts with: the carrier account behind the labels, where the goods leave from and where returns go, the defaults, and the packing station's printers.

read.failed: The shipping settings could not be read

forbidden.title: You cannot see the shipping settings
forbidden.body: Seeing them needs the right to see the shipping settings (shipping.settings.view). Ask an administrator.

problem.forbidden: You may not see these settings.

noSites.title: No site to set up
noSites.body: None of this company's sites is within your access. An administrator gives access to a site.

test.FAKE: Test account: labels say TEST, nothing is bought and nothing reaches a carrier.
test.SANDBOX: Sendcloud test use: labels are for trying things out; never hand one to a driver.

conflict.title: Someone else changed these settings meanwhile
conflict.body: Your changes are still here and nothing was saved. Reload shows the settings as they are now (your changes here go).

problem.conflict: Someone else changed these settings meanwhile.
problem.notFound: This site's settings are not where they were: reload them.
problem.invalid: Some fields are not right: they say why.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.body_one: {count} change to these settings is not saved. Discarding brings back the settings as they were saved.
discard.body_other: {count} changes to these settings are not saved. Discarding brings back the settings as they were saved.

new.title: This site has no shipping settings yet
new.body: Add the address labels are sent from; Save creates the settings. Shipments from this site use them from then on.
new.titleReadOnly: This site has no shipping settings yet
new.bodyReadOnly: Someone who may change the shipping settings adds them.

readOnly.title: You can read these settings
readOnly.body: Changing them needs the right to change the shipping settings (shipping.settings.manage).

connection.title: Carrier connection
connection.intro: The Sendcloud account the labels of {site} are bought through: the company's own account.
connection.accountHint: The company's own Sendcloud accounts. A test account makes labels marked TEST.
connection.missingOption: An account that is no longer the company's
connection.name: Account
connection.missing: The account set for this site is not one of the company's carrier accounts any more: choose another one.
connection.noneSet: No carrier account is named for this site: labels use the company's only Sendcloud account, when it has exactly one. Choose one to be sure.
connection.setHidden: A carrier account is set for this site. Only an administrator sees and chooses the carrier accounts.
connection.noneHidden: No carrier account is named for this site: labels use the company's only Sendcloud account, when it has exactly one. An administrator names it.
connection.readFailed: The carrier accounts could not be read: {problem}

empty.title: Connect a carrier account to buy labels
empty.body: The company has no Sendcloud account yet. It is connected in Admin › Connections & API.

connection.where: The account is connected, its keys replaced and disconnected in Admin › Connections & API.

state.pausedBody: This account is paused: no label can be bought until an administrator resumes it.
state.noCredentialsBody: This account has no keys stored: no label can be bought until an administrator stores them.

sender.title: Ship-from address
sender.intro: Printed on every carrier label and DDT as the sender.

returns.title: Return address
returns.intro: Where a parcel the carrier cannot deliver comes back to.
returns.same: Returns go to the ship-from address.

address.label: Address
address.name: Name
address.nameHint: Who sends the goods, as the label prints it.

defaults.title: Defaults for new shipments
defaults.intro: What a new shipment from this site starts with; each shipment can change them.

transportHint.SENDER: Our own van: the DDT says the sender carries them; no label is bought.
transportHint.RECIPIENT: The customer collects: the DDT says the recipient carries them; no label is bought.
transportHint.CARRIER: A carrier: labels are bought through the carrier account.

defaults.carrierHint: Sendcloud's carrier code, as brt, gls or poste_italiane.
defaults.serviceHint: Sendcloud's shipping option code for that carrier.
defaults.appearanceHint: The DDT's external appearance of the goods.
defaults.cutOffHint: HH:MM, Italian time. After it, parcels leave the next working day.

printers.title: Packing station printers
printers.intro: Where the packing station prints: carrier labels on a label printer, the DDT and the packing list on an A4 printer.

hint.labelPrinterId: A label printer (ZPL) of this site.
hint.documentPrinterId: An A4 printer of this site.

noneAtSite.labelPrinterId: This site has no label printer yet: it is added in Admin › Devices & printers.
noneAtSite.documentPrinterId: This site has no A4 printer yet: it is added in Admin › Devices & printers.

none.labelPrinterId: None: labels print as PDFs from the browser
none.documentPrinterId: None: the office prints the DDT and packing list

printers.unknown: A printer that is no longer at this site
printers.hidden: You cannot see this site's printers (it needs the right to see printers); the ones set stay as they are.
printers.readFailed: The site's printers could not be read: {problem}

problem.email: This is not an e-mail address.

problem.cutOff: A time of day as HH:MM, as 17:00.
